claims.statement: Tom Allen was due to sign articles for a fight with Joe Goss at Cincinnati on May 12, 1876.
claims.excerpt: from signing pepers at Cincinnati, to-morrow

claims.statement: Sporting circles expected Tom Allen to insist on a fight with Joe Goss within twelve weeks of signing articles.
claims.excerpt: that Tom Allen will insist upon a fight with Goss within twelve weeks from signing

claims.statement: Some men claiming to be posted said Joe Goss would not agree to a meeting with Tom Allen for four months after signing articles and might stave the match off.
claims.excerpt: and that Goss will not agree toa meting short of four months from signing articles

notes: Rumour and expectation from sporting circles, not a made match. Unrelated police item on the same page is ignored.
